'''Guilherme Carvalho dos Santos''' (born 22 June 2002) is a Brazilian professional [[basketball]] player for [[Minas Tênis Clube|Minas]] of the [[Novo Basquete Brasil]] (NBB).

==Professional career==
Santos made his professional debut with [[Minas Tênis Clube|Minas]] during the [[2018–19 NBB season]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Fábrica de talentos |url=https://minastenisclube.com.br/noticias/basquete-formado-na-base-do-minas-gui-santos-esta-inscrito-no-draft/ |publisher=[[Minas Tênis Clube]] |access-date=3 June 2021 |language=Portuguese |date=23 April 2021}}</ref> Two years later, he entered the starting lineup. In April 2021, Santos was named to the World Team for the [[Nike Hoop Summit]]. On April 21, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=Brazil's Gui Santos entering 2021 NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/31302089/brazil-gui-santos-entering-2021-nba-draft |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=June 3, 2021 |date=April 21, 2021}}</ref>

==National team career==
Santos helped Brazil win a gold medal at the 2019 [[FIBA South America Under-17 Championship for Men|FIBA South America Under-17 Championship]] in Chile. He scored 27 points against [[Argentina men's national under-17 basketball team|Argentina]] in the final.<ref>{{cite web |title=Brazil claim South American U17 Championship 2019 title in Chile |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/u17sudamericano/2019/news/brazil-claim-south-american-u17-championship-2019-title-in-chile |publisher=[[FIBA]] |access-date=3 June 2021 |date=1 December 2019}}</ref> Santos made his [[Brazil men's national basketball team|senior national team]] debut during [[2022 FIBA AmeriCup qualification]].<ref name=massi>{{cite web |last1=Massi |first1=Luciano |title=Gui Santos, do Minas e Seleção Brasileira, comenta sobre grande fase no NBB 13 |url=https://www.radiopoliesportiva.com.br/gui-santos-do-minas-e-selecao-brasileira-comenta-sobre-grande-fase-no-nbb-13/ |website=Rádio Poliesportiva |access-date=3 June 2021 |language=Portuguese |date=11 March 2021}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Santos' father, Deivisson, is a former professional basketball player who played five seasons in the NBB.<ref name=massi/> His mother, Lucineide, was also a basketball player.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Sasso |first1=Leonardo |last2=Suaide |first2=Pedro |title=NBB: armador de 16 anos do Minas Tênis Clube joga por 3 categorias, brinca sobre ENEM e é desafiado por companheiros |url=https://www.espn.com.br/basquete/artigo/_/id/4974298/nbb-armador-de-16-anos-do-minas-tenis-clube-joga-por-3-categorias-brinca-sobre-enem-e-e-desafiado-por-companheiros |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=3 June 2021 |language=Portuguese |date=13 November 2018}}</ref>
